definition_record.definition: Compute AUROC from negative and watermarked z-score arrays and report TPR at FPR bounds of zero, one percent, and five percent.
definition_record.replay_mapping: Watermarked z scores come from observed match counts. Negative scores are the exact fair-bit binomial null pooled over the observed surviving-site distribution.

imported_definition: AUROC and TPR at declared FPR bounds from negative and positive z-score arrays
reason_full_system_not_executed: Requires language-model generation and evaluation dependencies outside the frozen CPU-only no-model contract
